corePassives.description: Grimmjow's technique, Ultimate, and counterattack apply Destruction Mark to enemies. It can be detonated by basic attacks during the Ultimate, basic attacks chained after a technique or counterattack, granting 1 point of Spiritual Pressure Reserve. Each point of Spiritual Pressure Reserve increases Grimmjow's Basic ASPD and Strike DMG by 3%, up to 5 points. During battle, Grimmjow's Spiritual Pressure continuously drains. The more Spiritual Pressure Reserve he has, the faster it drains. When Spiritual Pressure reaches zero, 1 point of Spiritual Pressure Reserve is automatically deducted. Grimmjow can use his Ultimate once his Ultimate Energy reaches 50%.
corePassives.name: Worthy Prey

corePassives.description: Using Sonido to ram into enemies allows Grimmjow to trigger Perfect Dodge manually. During Form of Destruction, after using his Ultimate, Perfect Dodge also triggers automatically whenever he is attacked. Each trigger increases Grimmjow's Strike DMG by 20% for 20 seconds.
corePassives.name: Swift and Deadly

corePassives.description: During battle, Grimmjow's Strike DMG increases by an amount equal to 15% of his Ultimate Charge Rate.
corePassives.name: Fervor

corePassives.description: When releasing his Ultimate, if Ultimate Energy is above 50%, the excess portion increases the damage of Gran Rey Cero and Enhanced Basic Attack, Form of Destruction, at a certain ratio, up to 100%. Each time Grimmjow defeats an enemy in battle, he gains Spiritual Pressure and Ultimate Energy.
corePassives.name: Impulse
